messages.author: e5371cb7ccb9b3ec
messages.subject: Invalid blocks with .findSpatialBlocks
parts:
Hello Kylie,

I am trying DESI-Orbitrap imaging and am creating image files by converting .RAW files (each is a full row in a flyback raster pattern) to .mzML files, then those to .imzML image files using GNPS' converter (https://gnps-quickstart.ucsd.edu/conversion) and Alan Race's imzMLConverter, respectively. The image data can be normalized, smoothed, etc. and false color images made without issue. However, when I try to perform spatial shrunken centroids or spatially aware k-means clustering, I get the error "Error in .findSpatialBlocks(.object, groups = run(.object), nblocks = .blocks,  : 
  invalid blocks". Is there some way to fix this?

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Invalid blocks with .findSpatialBlocks
parts:
This usually occurs due to an extraneous z-dimension in the coordinates in previous versions of Cardinal. Upgrading to a newer version 2.6 in BioC 3.11 will fix it. To stay on an older version, you can remove the z-dimension:

coord(mse)$z <- NULL

-Kylie
